sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Lung Nodule Malignancy Prediction in Sequential CT Scans: Summary of ISBI 2018 Challenge》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】While lung nodules are detected with a high rate of sensitivity, this exam has a low specificity rate and it is still difficult to separate benign and malignant lesions.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】Participants were evaluated based on the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of nodule-wise malignancy scores generated by their algorithms on the test set.

evidence.text: While lung nodules are detected with a high rate of sensitivity, this exam has a low specificity rate and it is still difficult to separate benign and malignant lesions.
Participants were evaluated based on the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of nodule-wise malignancy scores generated by their algorithms on the test set.
